According to the schematic of the chargers, the Surge Protection is declared as basic, as so, it should be 1 in the place of the 2 below.
I changed the value and now we don't have error flags. If you agree I will close the ticket since it's been solved.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0382011
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
